internal/LibTmux/Internal/Capture.hs.content:
-- | Acquisition of detached physical graphs and the finite Snapshot profile.
--
-- 'captureSnapshot' includes daemon metadata and attached clients; 'captureGraph'
-- acquires only physical entities and links. Read failures and cancellation
-- can leave logical uncertainty. t'CaptureRecovery' in the exception context
-- retains the exact read and its recovery owner, without retaining its result.
-- "LibTmux.Server" owns the public scope and cleanup policy.
module LibTmux.Internal.Capture
  ( CapturedGraph, CapturedSnapshot, CaptureError (..), captureGraph, captureGraphWith, captureSnapshot, captureSnapshotWith
  , captureVersionWith, captureIdentityWith
  , CaptureRecovery, captureRecoveries, recoveryReceipt, inspectRecovery, resumeRecovery, detachRecovery
  ) where

import Control.Concurrent.STM (STM)
import Control.DeepSeq (NFData, force)
import Control.Exception (Exception, ExceptionWithContext (..), Handler (..), SomeException,
  catchNoPropagate, catches, evaluate, mask, onException, rethrowIO, someExceptionContext, throwIO)
import Control.Exception.Annotation (ExceptionAnnotation)
import Control.Exception.Context qualified as Context
import Control.Monad (forM, when)
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.ByteString qualified as Bytes
import Data.IORef
import Data.Maybe (listToMaybe)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import LibTmux.Internal.Graph qualified as G
import LibTmux.Internal.Graph qualified as Session (Session (..))
import LibTmux.Internal.Graph qualified as Window (Window (..))
import LibTmux.Internal.Field qualified as Field
import LibTmux.Internal.Process qualified as P
import LibTmux.Internal.Runtime qualified as R
import LibTmux.Internal.Scheduler qualified as S
import LibTmux.Internal.SocketPin (pinGeneration)
import LibTmux.Version qualified as Version
import LibTmux.Internal.Topology qualified as T
import System.Timeout (timeout)

type CapturedGraph = (Word64, Word64, G.EntityGraph)
type CapturedSnapshot = (Word64, Word64, G.Snapshot)

data CaptureError
  = CaptureChanged | CaptureDeadline | InvalidCaptureDeadline !Int
  | CaptureByteLimit !Integer | InvalidCapturedField !Field.FieldError
  | CaptureReadUnavailable !S.Outcome
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance Exception CaptureError

-- | A reachable owner for one failed or cancelled capture. The receipt holds
-- metadata only; the Runtime retains any remaining native and logical owners.
data CaptureRecovery = CaptureRecovery !R.Runtime !R.ServerHandle !R.ReadReceipt
instance Show CaptureRecovery where
  showsPrec precedence (CaptureRecovery _ _ receipt) =
    showParen (precedence > 10) (showString "CaptureRecovery " . shows receipt)
instance ExceptionAnnotation CaptureRecovery

captureRecoveries :: SomeException -> [CaptureRecovery]
captureRecoveries = Context.getExceptionAnnotations . someExceptionContext

recoveryReceipt :: CaptureRecovery -> R.ReadReceipt
recoveryReceipt (CaptureRecovery _ _ receipt) = receipt

inspectRecovery :: CaptureRecovery -> STM R.ReadRecovery
inspectRecovery (CaptureRecovery runtime client receipt) = R.inspectReceipt runtime client receipt

-- | Resume only existing cleanup, leaving Runtime admission open. Never retry
-- the tmux read; a new capture is a separately requested observation.
resumeRecovery :: CaptureRecovery -> IO ()
resumeRecovery (CaptureRecovery runtime client receipt) = R.resumeReceipt runtime client receipt

-- | Explicitly release logical uncertainty without releasing native owners.
detachRecovery :: CaptureRecovery -> STM Bool
detachRecovery (CaptureRecovery runtime client receipt) = R.detachReceipt runtime client receipt

-- | Qualify adoption through the same bounded read/recovery ownership as a
-- capture. The version probe runs no tmux after-hook and acquires no graph.
captureVersionWith :: P.Hooks -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> Int -> IO (Word64, Word64, Version.TmuxVersion)
captureVersionWith = captureProbe R.readServerVersionWith

-- | The daemon's PID through the same hook-free probe, bounded and correlated like 'captureVersionWith'.
captureIdentityWith :: P.Hooks -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> Int -> IO (Word64, Word64, Integer)
captureIdentityWith = captureProbe R.readServerIdentityWith

captureProbe
  :: NFData value
  => (P.Hooks -> Int -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> R.ReadClass -> IO (R.Request value))
  -> P.Hooks -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> Int -> IO (Word64, Word64, value)
captureProbe start hooks runtime client executable duration = withinDeadline runtime client duration $ \receipt deadline -> do
  left <- remaining deadline
  owned runtime receipt (start hooks left runtime client executable R.ScalarRead)

captureGraph :: R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> Int -> IO CapturedGraph
captureGraph runtime client executable duration = withinDeadline runtime client duration $ \receipt deadline -> do
  left <- remaining deadline
  owned runtime receipt (R.readGraphWith P.defaultHooks left runtime client executable)

captureSnapshot :: R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> Int -> IO CapturedSnapshot
captureSnapshot = captureSnapshotWith P.defaultHooks

-- | Use the native process checkpoints while retaining capture correlation
-- across worker handoff, cancellation and conversion of a deadline failure.
captureSnapshotWith :: P.Hooks -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> Int -> IO CapturedSnapshot
captureSnapshotWith hooks runtime client executable duration = withinDeadline runtime client duration $ \receipt deadline -> do
  left <- remaining deadline
  owned runtime receipt (R.readSnapshotWith hooks left runtime client executable)

-- | Serial comparison path with a checkpoint before its final topology read.
-- The production capture path uses one tagged envelope instead.
captureGraphWith :: IO () -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> Int -> IO CapturedGraph
captureGraphWith checkpoint runtime client executable duration =
  withinDeadline runtime client duration (\receipt deadline -> R.withCaptureBudget runtime (attempt receipt deadline 2))
  where
    generation = pinGeneration (R.serverPin client)
    attempt :: IORef (Maybe R.ReadReceipt) -> Word64 -> Int -> IO G.EntityGraph
    attempt receipt deadline tries = oneAttempt receipt deadline `catches`
      [ Handler $ \problem -> case problem of
          CaptureChanged -> retry receipt deadline tries
          _ -> throwIO problem
      , Handler $ \problem -> case problem of
          T.TopologyGraphError _ -> retry receipt deadline tries
          _ -> throwIO problem
      , Handler $ \problem -> case problem of
          R.InvalidEntityReceipt -> retry receipt deadline tries
          _ -> throwIO problem
      ]
    retry receipt deadline tries
      | tries > 1 = attempt receipt deadline (tries - 1)
      | otherwise = throwIO CaptureChanged
    oneAttempt receipt deadline = do
      retained <- newIORef 0
      let charge amount = do
            old <- readIORef retained
            let total = old + amount
            when (total > 64 * 1024 * 1024) (throwIO (CaptureByteLimit total))
            writeIORef retained total
          topology = do
            left <- remaining deadline
            bytes <- owned runtime receipt (R.readTopologyWith P.defaultHooks left runtime client executable R.ScalarRead)
            charge (4 * toInteger (Bytes.length bytes))
            graph <- either throwIO pure (T.decodeTopology generation bytes)
            -- Both topology graphs coexist; reserve their metadata and payloads.
            charge (1024 * toInteger (length (G.graphSessions graph) + length (G.graphWindows graph)
              + length (G.graphPanes graph) + length (G.graphLinks graph)))
            pure graph
          scalar field = do
            left <- remaining deadline
            bytes <- owned runtime receipt (R.readEntityFieldWith field P.defaultHooks left runtime client executable R.ScalarRead)
            charge (4 * toInteger (Bytes.length bytes))
            pure bytes
          decoded :: Field.Field row value -> R.EntityField -> IO value
          decoded field target = do
            bytes <- scalar target
            either (throwIO . InvalidCapturedField) pure (Field.decodeField field bytes)
      before <- topology
      sessions <- forM (G.graphSessions before) $ \row -> do
        name <- decoded Field.SessionName (R.SessionName (Field.project Field.SessionId row))
        pure row {Session.name = name}
      windows <- forM (G.graphWindows before) $ \row -> do
        name <- decoded Field.WindowName (R.WindowName (Field.project Field.WindowId row))
        pure row {Window.name = name}
      panes <- forM (G.graphPanes before) $ \row -> do
        let ident = Field.project Field.PaneId row
        title <- decoded Field.PaneTitle (R.PaneTitle ident)
        command <- decoded Field.PaneCommand (R.PaneCommand ident)
        path <- decoded Field.PanePath (R.PanePath ident)
        pure row {G.title = title, G.currentCommand = command, G.currentPath = path}
      checkpoint
      after <- topology
      when (before /= after) (throwIO CaptureChanged)
      graph <- either (const (throwIO CaptureChanged)) pure
        (G.assembleEntityGraph generation sessions windows panes (G.graphLinks before))
      evaluate (force graph)

withinDeadline :: NFData value => R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> Int
  -> (IORef (Maybe R.ReadReceipt) -> Word64 -> IO value) -> IO (Word64, Word64, value)
withinDeadline runtime client duration action = mask $ \restore -> do
  when (duration < 1 || duration > 10000000) (throwIO (InvalidCaptureDeadline duration))
  receipt <- newIORef Nothing
  let annotate (ExceptionWithContext context (problem :: SomeException)) = do
        current <- readIORef receipt
        let selected = case current of
              Just value -> Just value
              Nothing -> listToMaybe (Context.getExceptionAnnotations @R.ReadReceipt context)
            annotated = case selected of
              Nothing -> context
              Just !value ->
                let !recovery = CaptureRecovery runtime client value
                in Context.addExceptionAnnotation recovery context
        rethrowIO (ExceptionWithContext annotated problem)
  catchNoPropagate (restore (timed receipt)) annotate
  where
    timed receipt = do
      started <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
      let delta = fromIntegral duration * 1000
      when (started > maxBound - delta) (throwIO R.ReadClockOverflow)
      let deadline = started + delta
      left <- remaining deadline
      completed <- timeout left (action receipt deadline >>= evaluate . force)
      graph <- maybe (throwIO CaptureDeadline) pure completed
      ended <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
      when (ended >= deadline) (throwIO CaptureDeadline)
      pure (started, ended, graph)

owned :: R.Runtime -> IORef (Maybe R.ReadReceipt) -> IO (R.Request value) -> IO value
owned runtime receipt start = mask $ \restore -> do
  writeIORef receipt Nothing
  request <- catchNoPropagate start $ \problem@(ExceptionWithContext context (_ :: SomeException)) -> do
    -- System.Timeout consumes its private exception. Copy correlation before
    -- that conversion, including when start never returns a Request.
    case Context.getExceptionAnnotations @R.ReadReceipt context of
      current : _ -> current `seq` writeIORef receipt (Just current)
      [] -> pure ()
    rethrowIO problem
  let !current = R.readReceipt request
  writeIORef receipt (Just current)
  response <- restore (R.awaitRead request) `onException` R.cancelRead runtime request
  case response of
    R.ReadValue value -> pure value
    R.ReadUnavailable _ (Just problem) -> throwIO problem
    R.ReadUnavailable outcome Nothing -> throwIO (CaptureReadUnavailable outcome)

remaining :: Word64 -> IO Int
remaining deadline = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  when (now >= deadline) (throwIO CaptureDeadline)
  pure (fromIntegral ((deadline - now + 999) `div` 1000))

-- | Synchronous detached creation with independently retained identity evidence.
-- The shared mutation runner owns deadline and operation correlation; this
-- layer preserves the journal when Timeout consumes an allocation exception.
module LibTmux.Internal.Creation
  ( performCreation, CreationRecovery, recoveryReceipt, observedReceipt
  , inspectRecovery, resumeRecovery, awaitRecovery, detachRecovery
  ) where

import Control.Applicative ((<|>))
import Control.Concurrent.STM (STM)
import Control.DeepSeq (force)
import Control.Exception
import Control.Exception.Annotation (ExceptionAnnotation)
import Control.Exception.Context qualified as Context
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Maybe (listToMaybe)
import LibTmux.Creation (SessionOptions)
import LibTmux.Internal.Command qualified as C
import LibTmux.Internal.Graph qualified as G
import LibTmux.Internal.Mutation qualified as M
import LibTmux.Internal.Process qualified as P
import LibTmux.Internal.Process.Native qualified as N
import LibTmux.Internal.Runtime qualified as R
import LibTmux.Internal.Scope (TmuxException (..))
import LibTmux.Internal.SocketPin qualified as Pin
import System.Posix.Directory.ByteString qualified as Directory
import System.Posix.Env.ByteString qualified as Environment

-- | One failed creation's operation and its independently observed IDs.
-- The Runtime retains native/logical owners. Missing IDs do not prove absence.
data CreationRecovery = CreationRecovery !M.MutationRecovery !(Maybe R.CreationJournal)
instance Show CreationRecovery where
  showsPrec precedence (CreationRecovery recovery _) =
    showParen (precedence > 10) (showString "CreationRecovery " . shows recovery)
instance ExceptionAnnotation CreationRecovery

recoveryReceipt :: CreationRecovery -> R.ReadReceipt
recoveryReceipt (CreationRecovery recovery _) = M.recoveryReceipt recovery

observedReceipt :: CreationRecovery -> STM (Maybe G.CreatedSession)
observedReceipt recovery@(CreationRecovery _ journal) = do
  observed <- maybe (pure Nothing) R.journalReceipt journal
  let !generation = R.receiptGeneration (recoveryReceipt recovery)
  pure (createdValue generation <$> observed)

inspectRecovery :: CreationRecovery -> STM R.ReadRecovery
inspectRecovery (CreationRecovery recovery _) = M.inspectRecovery recovery

resumeRecovery :: CreationRecovery -> IO ()
resumeRecovery selected@(CreationRecovery recovery _) = recovering selected (M.resumeRecovery recovery)

awaitRecovery :: CreationRecovery -> IO R.ReadRecovery
awaitRecovery selected@(CreationRecovery recovery _) = recovering selected (M.awaitRecovery recovery)

detachRecovery :: CreationRecovery -> STM Bool
detachRecovery (CreationRecovery recovery _) = M.detachRecovery recovery

performCreation :: P.Hooks -> Int -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> SessionOptions -> IO G.CreatedSession
performCreation hooks duration runtime server executable options = mask $ \restore -> do
  journal <- newIORef Nothing
  let retain failure@(ExceptionWithContext context (_ :: SomeException)) = do
        writeIORef journal (listToMaybe (Context.getExceptionAnnotations @R.CreationJournal context))
        rethrowIO failure
      submit remainingTime = do
        (cwd, environment) <- restore $ do
          cwd <- Directory.getWorkingDirectory
          environment <- Environment.getEnvironment
          pure (cwd, environment)
        left <- remainingTime
        let context = (N.spec executable []) {N.cwd = cwd, N.env = [key <> "=" <> value | (key, value) <- environment]}
        created <- catchNoPropagate
          (R.createSessionWith hooks left runtime server context options) retain
        let !observed = R.creationJournal created
        writeIORef journal (Just observed)
        pure (R.creationRequest created)
      decode = \case
        C.SessionCreated value -> evaluate (force (createdValue generation value))
        C.SessionCreatedWithErrors _ diagnostic -> throwIO (MutationAppliedWithErrors diagnostic)
        C.SessionCreationRejected diagnostic -> throwIO (MutationRejected diagnostic)
        C.SessionCreationUnknown _ problem -> throwIO (R.InvalidCommandReply problem)
      annotate failure@(ExceptionWithContext context (_ :: SomeException)) =
        case Context.getExceptionAnnotations @M.MutationRecovery context of
          [] -> rethrowIO failure
          recovery : _ -> do
            saved <- readIORef journal
            let selected = saved <|> listToMaybe (Context.getExceptionAnnotations @R.CreationJournal context)
            recovering (CreationRecovery recovery selected) (rethrowIO failure)
      generation = Pin.pinGeneration (R.serverPin server)
  catchNoPropagate (restore (M.performRequest duration runtime server submit decode)) annotate

createdValue :: G.Generation -> C.SessionReceipt -> G.CreatedSession
createdValue generation receipt = G.CreatedSession receipt.serverPid
  (G.SessionRef generation receipt.sessionId) (G.WindowRef generation receipt.windowId)
  (G.PaneRef generation receipt.paneId) receipt.windowIndex

recovering :: CreationRecovery -> IO a -> IO a
recovering recovery action = catchNoPropagate action $
  \(ExceptionWithContext context (problem :: SomeException)) ->
    rethrowIO (ExceptionWithContext (Context.addExceptionAnnotation recovery context) problem)

-- | Closed field identities for the private observation profile.
--
-- Each 'Field' fixes its row and value types. Its descriptor supplies the
-- tmux variable, 'WireType' and pure 'project' operation together; transport
-- and local evaluation must not define independent field mappings.
-- 'decodeField' consumes already unescaped bytes, without trimming or IO.
module LibTmux.Internal.Field
  ( Field (..), SomeField (..), catalogue, WireType (..), FieldError (..), FieldFailure (..)
  , fieldKey, formatVariable, wireType, minimumTmux, project, decodeField
  ) where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.ByteString qualified as Bytes
import Data.ByteString.Char8 qualified as Ascii
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Text qualified as Text
import Data.Text.Encoding qualified as Utf8
import Foreign.C.Types (CInt)
import LibTmux.Id qualified as Id
import LibTmux.Internal.Graph qualified as G
import LibTmux.Internal.TmuxText qualified as Label
import LibTmux.Value qualified as V
import LibTmux.Version qualified as Version
import System.OsPath.Posix (PosixPath)
import System.OsString.Posix (PosixString)
import System.OsString.Posix qualified as Os

-- | Fields belong to physical rows or contextual links, never both implicitly.
data Field row value where
  ServerPid :: Field G.ServerInfo Integer
  ServerStartedAt :: Field G.ServerInfo Integer
  ServerVersion :: Field G.ServerInfo Version.TmuxVersion
  ServerSocketPath :: Field G.ServerInfo PosixPath
  ClientName :: Field G.Client PosixString
  ClientPid :: Field G.Client Integer
  ClientTty :: Field G.Client (Maybe PosixPath)
  ClientSession :: Field G.ClientAttachment Id.SessionId
  ClientWindow :: Field G.ClientAttachment Id.WindowId
  ClientWindowIndex :: Field G.ClientAttachment V.WindowIndex
  ClientPane :: Field G.ClientAttachment Id.PaneId
  SessionId :: Field G.Session Id.SessionId
  SessionName :: Field G.Session Text
  SessionAttached :: Field G.Session Integer
  WindowId :: Field G.Window Id.WindowId
  WindowName :: Field G.Window Label.TmuxText
  WindowWidth :: Field G.Window V.Dimension
  WindowHeight :: Field G.Window V.Dimension
  PaneId :: Field G.Pane Id.PaneId
  PaneWindow :: Field G.Pane Id.WindowId
  PaneIndex :: Field G.Pane V.PaneIndex
  PaneWidth :: Field G.Pane V.Dimension
  PaneHeight :: Field G.Pane V.Dimension
  PaneActive :: Field G.Pane Bool
  PaneDead :: Field G.Pane Bool
  PaneTitle :: Field G.Pane Text
  PaneCommand :: Field G.Pane PosixString
  PanePath :: Field G.Pane PosixPath
  LinkSession :: Field G.WindowLink Id.SessionId
  LinkWindow :: Field G.WindowLink Id.WindowId
  LinkIndex :: Field G.WindowLink V.WindowIndex
  LinkActive :: Field G.WindowLink Bool

-- | The finite native catalogue, without erasing each descriptor's evidence.
data SomeField where
  SomeField :: Field row value -> SomeField

catalogue :: [SomeField]
catalogue =
  [ SomeField ServerPid, SomeField ServerStartedAt, SomeField ServerVersion, SomeField ServerSocketPath
  , SomeField ClientName, SomeField ClientPid, SomeField ClientTty
  , SomeField ClientSession, SomeField ClientWindow, SomeField ClientWindowIndex, SomeField ClientPane
  , SomeField SessionId, SomeField SessionName, SomeField SessionAttached
  , SomeField WindowId, SomeField WindowName, SomeField WindowWidth, SomeField WindowHeight
  , SomeField PaneId, SomeField PaneWindow, SomeField PaneIndex, SomeField PaneWidth, SomeField PaneHeight
  , SomeField PaneActive, SomeField PaneDead, SomeField PaneTitle, SomeField PaneCommand, SomeField PanePath
  , SomeField LinkSession, SomeField LinkWindow, SomeField LinkIndex, SomeField LinkActive
  ]

-- | Checked wire domains. POSIX path and string share a representation but
-- retain different descriptors; neither promises local filesystem semantics.
data WireType value where
  SessionIdValue :: WireType Id.SessionId
  WindowIdValue :: WireType Id.WindowId
  PaneIdValue :: WireType Id.PaneId
  TextValue :: WireType Text
  LabelValue :: WireType Label.TmuxText
  PosixStringValue :: WireType PosixString
  PosixPathValue :: WireType PosixPath
  NonEmptyPosixStringValue :: WireType PosixString
  NonEmptyPosixPathValue :: WireType PosixPath
  OptionalPosixPathValue :: WireType (Maybe PosixPath)
  ProcessIdValue :: WireType Integer
  EpochSecondsValue :: WireType Integer
  VersionValue :: WireType Version.TmuxVersion
  DimensionValue :: WireType V.Dimension
  PaneIndexValue :: WireType V.PaneIndex
  WindowIndexValue :: WireType V.WindowIndex
  AttachedCountValue :: WireType Integer
  BooleanValue :: WireType Bool

data Descriptor row value = Descriptor !Text !ByteString !(WireType value) !(row -> value)

descriptor :: Field row value -> Descriptor row value
descriptor = \case
  ServerPid -> Descriptor "server.pid" "pid" ProcessIdValue (.pid)
  ServerStartedAt -> Descriptor "server.startedAt" "start_time" EpochSecondsValue (.startedAt)
  ServerVersion -> Descriptor "server.version" "version" VersionValue (.version)
  ServerSocketPath -> Descriptor "server.socketPath" "socket_path" NonEmptyPosixPathValue (.socketPath)
  ClientName -> Descriptor "client.name" "client_name" NonEmptyPosixStringValue (.name)
  ClientPid -> Descriptor "client.pid" "client_pid" ProcessIdValue (.pid)
  ClientTty -> Descriptor "client.tty" "client_tty" OptionalPosixPathValue (.tty)
  ClientSession -> Descriptor "client.session" "session_id" SessionIdValue (\row -> sessionId row.session.ref)
  ClientWindow -> Descriptor "client.window" "window_id" WindowIdValue (\row -> windowId row.window.ref)
  ClientWindowIndex -> Descriptor "client.windowIndex" "window_index" WindowIndexValue (\row -> row.pane.link.index)
  ClientPane -> Descriptor "client.pane" "pane_id" PaneIdValue (\row -> paneId row.pane.pane.ref)
  SessionId -> Descriptor "session.id" "session_id" SessionIdValue (sessionId . (.ref))
  SessionName -> Descriptor "session.name" "session_name" TextValue (.name)
  SessionAttached -> Descriptor "session.attached" "session_attached" AttachedCountValue (.attached)
  WindowId -> Descriptor "window.id" "window_id" WindowIdValue (windowId . (.ref))
  WindowName -> Descriptor "window.name" "window_name" LabelValue (.name)
  WindowWidth -> Descriptor "window.width" "window_width" DimensionValue (.width)
  WindowHeight -> Descriptor "window.height" "window_height" DimensionValue (.height)
  PaneId -> Descriptor "pane.id" "pane_id" PaneIdValue (paneId . (.ref))
  PaneWindow -> Descriptor "pane.window" "window_id" WindowIdValue (windowId . (.window))
  PaneIndex -> Descriptor "pane.index" "pane_index" PaneIndexValue (.index)
  PaneWidth -> Descriptor "pane.width" "pane_width" DimensionValue (.width)
  PaneHeight -> Descriptor "pane.height" "pane_height" DimensionValue (.height)
  PaneActive -> Descriptor "pane.active" "pane_active" BooleanValue (.active)
  PaneDead -> Descriptor "pane.dead" "pane_dead" BooleanValue (.dead)
  PaneTitle -> Descriptor "pane.title" "pane_title" TextValue (.title)
  PaneCommand -> Descriptor "pane.currentCommand" "pane_current_command" PosixStringValue (.currentCommand)
  PanePath -> Descriptor "pane.currentPath" "pane_current_path" PosixPathValue (.currentPath)
  LinkSession -> Descriptor "windowLink.session" "session_id" SessionIdValue (sessionId . (.session))
  LinkWindow -> Descriptor "windowLink.window" "window_id" WindowIdValue (windowId . (.window))
  LinkIndex -> Descriptor "windowLink.index" "window_index" WindowIndexValue (.index)
  LinkActive -> Descriptor "windowLink.active" "window_active" BooleanValue (.active)

sessionId :: G.SessionRef -> Id.SessionId
sessionId (G.SessionRef _ ident) = ident

windowId :: G.WindowRef -> Id.WindowId
windowId (G.WindowRef _ ident) = ident

paneId :: G.PaneRef -> Id.PaneId
paneId (G.PaneRef _ ident) = ident

-- | Stable model-qualified key; independent of the Haskell constructor name.
fieldKey :: Field row value -> Text
fieldKey field = case descriptor field of Descriptor key _ _ _ -> key

-- | Trusted tmux variable name, without format delimiters or caller input.
formatVariable :: Field row value -> ByteString
formatVariable field = case descriptor field of Descriptor _ variable _ _ -> variable

-- | Type evidence for scalar decoding and typed query interpretation.
wireType :: Field row value -> WireType value
wireType field = case descriptor field of Descriptor _ _ valueType _ -> valueType

-- | Minimum qualified profile, not the release that introduced each variable.
-- Every field in this finite profile is available at the tmux 3.3a floor.
minimumTmux :: Field row value -> Text
minimumTmux _ = "3.3a"

-- | Read an owned observation. This never navigates a graph or contacts tmux.
project :: Field row value -> row -> value
project field = case descriptor field of Descriptor _ _ _ get -> get

-- | A bounded diagnostic identifies the field without retaining its input.
data FieldError = FieldError !Text !FieldFailure
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

data FieldFailure = InvalidSyntax | InvalidEncoding | UnexpectedNul | ValueTooLarge !Int
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

-- | Validate decoded scalar bytes, retaining exact byte-bearing values.
-- One MiB is the scalar payload ceiling. Numeric ranges follow tmux
-- storage domains; the public mathematical newtypes have separate constructors.
decodeField :: Field row value -> ByteString -> Either FieldError value
decodeField field bytes
  | Bytes.length bytes > 1048576 = failure (ValueTooLarge (Bytes.length bytes))
  | Bytes.elem 0 bytes = failure UnexpectedNul
  | otherwise = either failure Right (decodeValue (wireType field) bytes)
  where
    failure = Left . FieldError (fieldKey field)

decodeValue :: WireType value -> ByteString -> Either FieldFailure value
decodeValue valueType bytes = case valueType of
  SessionIdValue -> ident Id.parseSessionId
  WindowIdValue -> ident Id.parseWindowId
  PaneIdValue -> ident Id.parsePaneId
  TextValue -> either (const (Left InvalidEncoding)) (Right . Text.copy) (Utf8.decodeUtf8' bytes)
  LabelValue -> Right (Label.fromBytes bytes)
  PosixStringValue -> Right (Os.fromBytestring bytes)
  PosixPathValue -> Right (Os.fromBytestring bytes)
  NonEmptyPosixStringValue -> if Bytes.null bytes then Left InvalidSyntax else Right (Os.fromBytestring bytes)
  NonEmptyPosixPathValue -> if Bytes.null bytes then Left InvalidSyntax else Right (Os.fromBytestring bytes)
  OptionalPosixPathValue -> Right (if Bytes.null bytes then Nothing else Just (Os.fromBytestring bytes))
  ProcessIdValue -> do
    value <- natural (toInteger (maxBound @CInt))
    if value > 0 then Right value else Left InvalidSyntax
  EpochSecondsValue -> number 19 9223372036854775807
  VersionValue -> either (const (Left InvalidSyntax)) Right
    (Version.parseVersion (Utf8.decodeLatin1 bytes) >>= Version.requireSupported)
  DimensionValue -> natural 4294967295 >>= checked V.mkDimension
  PaneIndexValue -> natural 4294967295 >>= checked V.mkPaneIndex
  WindowIndexValue -> natural 2147483647 >>= checked V.mkWindowIndex
  AttachedCountValue -> natural 4294967295
  BooleanValue -> case bytes of
    "0" -> Right False
    "1" -> Right True
    _ -> Left InvalidSyntax
  where
    ident :: (Text -> Either error value) -> Either FieldFailure value
    ident parse
      | Bytes.length bytes > 11 = Left InvalidSyntax
      | otherwise = either (const (Left InvalidSyntax)) Right (parse (Utf8.decodeLatin1 bytes))
    natural :: Integer -> Either FieldFailure Integer
    natural = number 10
    number :: Int -> Integer -> Either FieldFailure Integer
    number digits upper
      | Bytes.null bytes || Bytes.length bytes > digits
        || not (Bytes.all (\byte -> byte >= 48 && byte <= 57) bytes) = Left InvalidSyntax
      | otherwise = case Ascii.readInteger bytes of
          Just (value, "") | value <= upper -> Right value
          _ -> Left InvalidSyntax
    checked :: (Integer -> Either error value) -> Integer -> Either FieldFailure value
    checked build = either (const (Left InvalidSyntax)) Right . build

-- | Detached physical entities, contextual links and validated graph indexes.
--
-- Window labels use 'TmuxText'; process names and paths preserve POSIX bytes.
-- Reading an observation or navigating the graph performs no IO.
-- 'assembleEntityGraph' validates references, unique positions and selections
-- for its ordered views and lookup indexes. 'assembleSnapshot' joins
-- metadata and attached clients, then forces the complete detached value.
module LibTmux.Internal.Graph
  ( EndpointIdentity (..), Generation (..)
  , SessionRef (..), WindowRef (..), PaneRef (..), CreatedSession (..)
  , Session (..), Window (..), Pane (..), WindowLink (..), PaneOccurrence (..)
  , EntityGraph, GraphError (..), LookupError (..), assembleEntityGraph
  , graphSessions, graphWindows, graphPanes, graphLinks, graphOccurrences
  , lookupSession, lookupWindow, lookupPane, linksForSession, panesForWindow
  , ServerInfo (..), Client (..), ClientAttachment (..), ClientInput (..)
  , Snapshot, serverInfo, entities, clients, assembleSnapshot
  , CaptureInterval (..), captureInterval, stampSnapshot
  ) where

import Control.DeepSeq (NFData (rnf), deepseq)
import Control.Monad (foldM, unless, void, when)
import Data.Bifunctor (first)
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.ByteString qualified as Bytes
import Data.List (sortOn)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Data.Set qualified as Set
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Foreign.C.Types (CInt)
import LibTmux.Id (PaneId, SessionId, WindowId)
import LibTmux.Internal.TmuxText (TmuxText)
import LibTmux.Value (Dimension, PaneIndex, WindowIndex)
import LibTmux.Version qualified as Version
import System.OsPath.Posix (PosixPath)
import System.OsString.Posix (PosixString)
import System.OsString.Posix qualified as Os

data EndpointIdentity = EndpointIdentity !Integer !Integer
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData EndpointIdentity where
  rnf (EndpointIdentity device inode) = rnf device `seq` rnf inode

-- | Opaque connection or offline-fixture identity. Independent Server handles
-- receive distinct tokens; named fixtures never equal an adopted endpoint.
data Generation = Generation !EndpointIdentity !ByteString
  | FixtureGeneration !Text
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData Generation where
  rnf (Generation endpoint token) = rnf endpoint `seq` rnf token
  rnf (FixtureGeneration name) = rnf name

-- | Session targeting identity within a t'Generation'. Compare observations
-- separately when their captured field values matter.
data SessionRef = SessionRef !Generation !SessionId
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData SessionRef where
  rnf (SessionRef generation ident) = rnf generation `seq` rnf ident

-- | Physical window targeting identity within a t'Generation'. A window can
-- have several t'WindowLink' appearances.
data WindowRef = WindowRef !Generation !WindowId
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData WindowRef where
  rnf (WindowRef generation ident) = rnf generation `seq` rnf ident

-- | Physical pane targeting identity within a t'Generation'. This carries
-- identity, while the supplied t'Snapshot' determines the observed values.
data PaneRef = PaneRef !Generation !PaneId
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData PaneRef where
  rnf (PaneRef generation ident) = rnf generation `seq` rnf ident

-- | Historical identities printed during detached new-session. A later hook
-- may already have removed them. Resolve through a fresh captured snapshot;
-- these references do not constitute hydrated observations or prove liveness.
-- Read these fields with record dot; construction remains private.
--
-- [#v:serverPid# @serverPid@ :: 'Integer'] Daemon PID printed with the receipt.
-- [#v:session# @session@ :: t'SessionRef'] Created session in the originating generation.
-- [#v:window# @window@ :: t'WindowRef'] Initial physical window.
-- [#v:pane# @pane@ :: t'PaneRef'] Initial physical pane.
-- [#v:windowIndex# @windowIndex@ :: t'WindowIndex'] Initial link index printed by tmux.
data CreatedSession = CreatedSession
  { serverPid :: !Integer -- ^ Daemon PID printed with the creation receipt.
  , session :: !SessionRef -- ^ Actual created session in the originating generation.
  , window :: !WindowRef -- ^ Actual initial physical window.
  , pane :: !PaneRef -- ^ Actual initial physical pane.
  , windowIndex :: !WindowIndex -- ^ Initial link index printed by tmux.
  } deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData CreatedSession where
  rnf (CreatedSession pid session window pane index) =
    rnf pid `seq` rnf session `seq` rnf window `seq` rnf pane `seq` rnf index

-- | Detached physical session. Navigate its appearances through t'WindowLink'.
data Session = Session
  { ref :: !SessionRef -- ^ Target identity in the observation's generation.
  , name :: !Text -- ^ Session name as reported and decoded by tmux.
  , attached :: !Integer -- ^ Nonnegative reported count, independent of the captured client listing.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Session where
  rnf (Session ref name attached) = rnf (ref, name, attached)

-- | Detached physical window, independent of its session and index appearances.
data Window = Window
  { ref :: !WindowRef -- ^ Shared identity across this snapshot's window links.
  , name :: !TmuxText -- ^ Reported bytes, including non-text names on older tmux.
  , width :: !Dimension -- ^ Positive terminal width in cells.
  , height :: !Dimension -- ^ Positive terminal height in cells.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Window where
  rnf (Window ref name width height) = rnf (ref, name, width, height)

-- | Detached physical pane. Its window can appear in several session contexts;
-- t'PaneOccurrence' preserves an appearance without duplicating physical identity.
data Pane = Pane
  { ref :: !PaneRef -- ^ Pane identity in the observation's generation.
  , window :: !WindowRef -- ^ Containing physical window, resolved against a snapshot.
  , index :: !PaneIndex -- ^ Nonnegative pane index within that window.
  , width :: !Dimension -- ^ Positive terminal width in cells.
  , height :: !Dimension -- ^ Positive terminal height in cells.
  , active :: !Bool -- ^ The window's active pane, rather than a separate client focus.
  , dead :: !Bool -- ^ Whether tmux reports the pane process as dead.
  , title :: !Text -- ^ Valid UTF-8 pane title reported by tmux.
  , currentCommand :: !PosixString -- ^ Reported process name; tmux may normalize it.
  , currentPath :: !PosixPath -- ^ Endpoint data, without local path interpretation.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Pane where
  rnf (Pane ref window index width height active dead title command path) =
    rnf ((ref, window, index, width, height), (active, dead, title, command, path))

-- | One observed session/index/window binding. Indices are reusable positions;
-- this value describes captured context. The same window may appear repeatedly.
data WindowLink = WindowLink
  { session :: !SessionRef -- ^ Session containing this appearance.
  , index :: !WindowIndex -- ^ Position of this link within the session.
  , window :: !WindowRef -- ^ Physical window shared by its appearances.
  , active :: !Bool -- ^ Whether this is the session's selected window link.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData WindowLink where
  rnf (WindowLink session index window active) = rnf (session, index, window, active)

-- | A physical pane together with one contextual window appearance.
data PaneOccurrence = PaneOccurrence
  { pane :: !Pane -- ^ Captured physical pane value.
  , link :: !WindowLink -- ^ Session and index context through which it appears.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData PaneOccurrence where
  rnf (PaneOccurrence pane link) = rnf (pane, link)

-- | Reported daemon metadata within one adopted generation. PID and start
-- time are observations; they do not grant signal authority or durable identity.
data ServerInfo = ServerInfo
  { generation :: !Generation -- ^ Connection identity shared by all references in this snapshot.
  , pid :: !Integer -- ^ Positive daemon process ID reported by tmux.
  , startedAt :: !Integer -- ^ Daemon start time in whole seconds since the Unix epoch.
  , version :: !Version.TmuxVersion -- ^ Release admitted by "LibTmux.Version".
  , socketPath :: !PosixPath -- ^ Reported endpoint path, preserved as POSIX bytes.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData ServerInfo where
  rnf (ServerInfo generation pid startedAt version socketPath) = rnf generation
    `seq` rnf pid `seq` rnf startedAt `seq` rnf (Version.renderVersion version) `seq` rnf socketPath

-- | An attachment contains this capture's values. It never resolves a retained
-- client name against a later capture. The pane is the session window's global
-- active pane, not an independent client focus; its link retains session context.
data ClientAttachment = ClientAttachment
  { session :: !Session -- ^ Captured attachment session.
  , window :: !Window -- ^ Captured physical selected window.
  , pane :: !PaneOccurrence -- ^ Selected pane with its session/window-link context.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData ClientAttachment where
  rnf (ClientAttachment session window pane) = rnf (session, window, pane)

-- | A detached client observation, not an operational connection or live ref.
-- The live profile lists attached clients; an offline value may be unattached.
data Client = Client
  { name :: !PosixString -- ^ Reported client-name bytes; names may be reused.
  , pid :: !Integer -- ^ Reported positive client process ID.
  , tty :: !(Maybe PosixPath) -- ^ Reported terminal path, when present.
  , attachment :: !(Maybe ClientAttachment) -- ^ Attachment values resolved within this capture.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Client where
  rnf (Client name pid tty attachment) = rnf (name, pid, tty, attachment)

-- Required native context from the attached-only listing, before graph lookup.
data ClientInput = ClientInput
  { name :: !PosixString
  , pid :: !Integer
  , tty :: !(Maybe PosixPath)
  , session :: !SessionId
  , window :: !WindowId
  , index :: !WindowIndex
  , pane :: !PaneId
  }

-- | Validated metadata, physical graph and attached-client observations.
-- Construction checks every join and forces owned values. List processing
-- and indexed lookup remain pure after the operational Server closes.
data Snapshot = Snapshot !ServerInfo !EntityGraph ![Client] !(Maybe CaptureInterval)
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Snapshot where
  rnf (Snapshot info graph rows interval) = rnf info `seq` rnf graph `seq` rnf rows `seq` rnf interval

-- | Daemon metadata captured with this graph.
serverInfo :: Snapshot -> ServerInfo
serverInfo (Snapshot info _ _ _) = info

entities :: Snapshot -> EntityGraph
entities (Snapshot _ graph _ _) = graph

-- | Captured attached clients in reported-name and PID order. Names may repeat.
clients :: Snapshot -> [Client]
clients (Snapshot _ _ rows _) = rows

-- | Monotonic process-clock bounds around acquisition. These values describe
-- an interval and do not promise an atomic observation or a wall-clock epoch.
data CaptureInterval = CaptureInterval
  { startedNanoseconds :: !Word64 -- ^ Monotonic time sampled before acquisition.
  , finishedNanoseconds :: !Word64 -- ^ Monotonic time after decoding and forcing.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData CaptureInterval where
  rnf (CaptureInterval started finished) = rnf started `seq` rnf finished

-- | Acquisition bounds attached to a live capture. An unstamped decoded
-- profile stays private; an offline fixture has no external capture interval.
captureInterval :: Snapshot -> Maybe CaptureInterval
captureInterval (Snapshot _ _ _ interval) = interval

stampSnapshot :: Word64 -> Word64 -> Snapshot -> Either GraphError Snapshot
stampSnapshot started finished (Snapshot info graph rows _)
  | started > finished = Left InvalidCaptureInterval
  | otherwise =
      let !interval = CaptureInterval started finished
      in Right (Snapshot info graph rows (Just interval))

data EntityGraph = EntityGraph
  { generation :: !Generation
  , sessions :: !(Map SessionRef Session)
  , windows :: !(Map WindowRef Window)
  , panes :: !(Map PaneRef Pane)
  , links :: !(Map (SessionRef, WindowIndex) WindowLink)
  , sessionLinks :: !(Map SessionRef [WindowLink])
  , windowPanes :: !(Map WindowRef [Pane])
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData EntityGraph where
  rnf graph = rnf graph.generation `seq` rnf graph.sessions `seq`
    rnf graph.windows `seq` rnf graph.panes `seq` rnf graph.links `seq`
    rnf graph.sessionLinks `seq` rnf graph.windowPanes

-- | A reference that cannot resolve in the supplied immutable snapshot.
-- Missing entities are distinct from a successfully observed empty relation.
data LookupError
  = ForeignGeneration -- ^ The reference belongs to another connection generation.
  | MissingSession !SessionRef -- ^ No session with this identity was captured.
  | MissingWindow !WindowRef -- ^ No physical window with this identity was captured.
  | MissingPane !PaneRef -- ^ No physical pane with this identity was captured.
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

data GraphError
  = InvalidGeneration
  | InvalidReference !LookupError
  | ConflictingSession !SessionRef
  | ConflictingWindow !WindowRef
  | ConflictingPane !PaneRef
  | DuplicateWindowSlot !SessionRef !WindowIndex
  | DuplicatePaneIndex !WindowRef !PaneIndex
  | InvalidAttachedCount !SessionRef !Integer
  | InvalidSessionSelection !SessionRef !Int
  | InvalidPaneSelection !WindowRef !Int
  | UnlinkedWindow !WindowRef
  | InvalidServerInfo
  | InvalidClientMetadata
  | MissingClientLink !SessionRef !WindowIndex
  | ChangedClientAttachment
  | InvalidCaptureInterval
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

assembleEntityGraph
  :: Generation -> [Session] -> [Window] -> [Pane] -> [WindowLink]
  -> Either GraphError EntityGraph
assembleEntityGraph generation sessionRows windowRows paneRows linkRows = do
  let valid = case generation of
        Generation (EndpointIdentity device inode) token ->
          device >= 0 && inode >= 0 && Bytes.length token == 32
        FixtureGeneration _ -> True
  unless valid (Left InvalidGeneration)
  mapM_ checkSession sessionRows
  mapM_ (checkWindowRef . (.ref)) windowRows
  mapM_ checkPane paneRows
  mapM_ checkLink linkRows
  sessions <- uniqueBy (.ref) ConflictingSession sessionRows
  windows <- uniqueBy (.ref) ConflictingWindow windowRows
  panes <- uniqueBy (.ref) ConflictingPane paneRows
  links <- foldM insertLink Map.empty linkRows
  let sessionLinks = Map.map (sortOn (\row -> (row.index, row.window))) $
        Map.fromListWith (<>) [(row.session, [row]) | row <- Map.elems links]
      windowPanes = Map.map (sortOn (\row -> (row.index, row.ref))) $
        Map.fromListWith (<>) [(row.window, [row]) | row <- Map.elems panes]
      graph = EntityGraph {generation, sessions, windows, panes, links, sessionLinks, windowPanes}
      linkedWindows = Set.fromList [row.window | row <- Map.elems links]
  mapM_ (\row -> first InvalidReference
    (lookupSession graph row.session >> lookupWindow graph row.window)) (Map.elems links)
  mapM_ (\row -> first InvalidReference (lookupWindow graph row.window)) (Map.elems panes)
  void (foldM checkPaneIndex Set.empty (Map.elems panes))
  mapM_ (checkSessionSelection sessionLinks) (Map.keys sessions)
  mapM_ (checkWindowSelection linkedWindows windowPanes) (Map.keys windows)
  graph `deepseq` Right graph
  where
    checkGeneration actual = unless (actual == generation) (Left (InvalidReference ForeignGeneration))
    checkSessionRef (SessionRef actual _) = checkGeneration actual
    checkWindowRef (WindowRef actual _) = checkGeneration actual
    checkSession row = do
      checkSessionRef row.ref
      when (row.attached < 0) (Left (InvalidAttachedCount row.ref row.attached))
    checkPane row = do
      let PaneRef actual _ = row.ref
      checkGeneration actual
      checkWindowRef row.window
    checkLink row = checkSessionRef row.session >> checkWindowRef row.window
    insertLink rows row
      | Map.member (row.session, row.index) rows = Left (DuplicateWindowSlot row.session row.index)
      | otherwise = Right (Map.insert (row.session, row.index) row rows)
    checkPaneIndex seen row
      | Set.member (row.window, row.index) seen = Left (DuplicatePaneIndex row.window row.index)
      | otherwise = Right (Set.insert (row.window, row.index) seen)
    checkSessionSelection rows ref =
      let selected = length (filter (.active) (Map.findWithDefault [] ref rows))
      in unless (selected == 1) (Left (InvalidSessionSelection ref selected))
    checkWindowSelection linked rows ref = do
      unless (Set.member ref linked) (Left (UnlinkedWindow ref))
      let selected = length (filter (.active) (Map.findWithDefault [] ref rows))
      unless (selected == 1) (Left (InvalidPaneSelection ref selected))

uniqueBy :: (Ord key, Eq row) => (row -> key) -> (key -> GraphError) -> [row] -> Either GraphError (Map key row)
uniqueBy key conflict = foldM insert Map.empty
  where
    insert rows row = case Map.lookup (key row) rows of
      Nothing -> Right (Map.insert (key row) row rows)
      Just old | old == row -> Right rows
      Just _ -> Left (conflict (key row))

graphSessions :: EntityGraph -> [Session]
graphSessions graph = Map.elems graph.sessions

graphWindows :: EntityGraph -> [Window]
graphWindows graph = Map.elems graph.windows

graphPanes :: EntityGraph -> [Pane]
graphPanes graph = Map.elems graph.panes

graphLinks :: EntityGraph -> [WindowLink]
graphLinks graph = Map.elems graph.links

graphOccurrences :: EntityGraph -> [PaneOccurrence]
graphOccurrences graph =
  [ PaneOccurrence pane link
  | link <- graphLinks graph
  , pane <- Map.findWithDefault [] link.window graph.windowPanes
  ]

lookupSession :: EntityGraph -> SessionRef -> Either LookupError Session
lookupSession graph ref@(SessionRef generation _)
  | generation /= graph.generation = Left ForeignGeneration
  | otherwise = maybe (Left (MissingSession ref)) Right (Map.lookup ref graph.sessions)

lookupWindow :: EntityGraph -> WindowRef -> Either LookupError Window
lookupWindow graph ref@(WindowRef generation _)
  | generation /= graph.generation = Left ForeignGeneration
  | otherwise = maybe (Left (MissingWindow ref)) Right (Map.lookup ref graph.windows)

lookupPane :: EntityGraph -> PaneRef -> Either LookupError Pane
lookupPane graph ref@(PaneRef generation _)
  | generation /= graph.generation = Left ForeignGeneration
  | otherwise = maybe (Left (MissingPane ref)) Right (Map.lookup ref graph.panes)

linksForSession :: EntityGraph -> SessionRef -> Either LookupError [WindowLink]
linksForSession graph ref = do
  _ <- lookupSession graph ref
  pure (Map.findWithDefault [] ref graph.sessionLinks)

panesForWindow :: EntityGraph -> WindowRef -> Either LookupError [Pane]
panesForWindow graph ref = do
  _ <- lookupWindow graph ref
  pure (Map.findWithDefault [] ref graph.windowPanes)

-- | Resolve the attached listing against its captured graph. A detached Client
-- keeps the resolved observations even after later selection or name reuse.
-- Session attached counts and listing cardinality have different tmux rules;
-- neither is reconstructed from the other.
assembleSnapshot :: ServerInfo -> EntityGraph -> [ClientInput] -> Either GraphError Snapshot
assembleSnapshot info graph inputs = do
  unless (info.generation == graph.generation) (Left (InvalidReference ForeignGeneration))
  unless (positivePid info.pid && info.startedAt >= 0 && info.startedAt <= 9223372036854775807
    && validString info.socketPath && not (Os.null info.socketPath)
    && either (const False) (const True) (Version.requireSupported info.version)) (Left InvalidServerInfo)
  rows <- mapM hydrate inputs
  let snapshot = Snapshot info graph (sortOn (\row -> (row.name, row.pid)) rows) Nothing
  snapshot `deepseq` Right snapshot
  where
    positivePid value = value > 0 && value <= toInteger (maxBound @CInt)
    validString value = Os.length value <= 1048576 && not (any ((== '\NUL') . Os.toChar) (Os.unpack value))
    hydrate input = do
      unless (positivePid input.pid && validString input.name && not (Os.null input.name)
        && maybe True (\path -> validString path && not (Os.null path)) input.tty) (Left InvalidClientMetadata)
      session <- first InvalidReference (lookupSession graph (SessionRef graph.generation input.session))
      window <- first InvalidReference (lookupWindow graph (WindowRef graph.generation input.window))
      pane <- first InvalidReference (lookupPane graph (PaneRef graph.generation input.pane))
      link <- maybe (Left (MissingClientLink session.ref input.index)) Right
        (Map.lookup (session.ref, input.index) graph.links)
      unless (link.window == window.ref && pane.window == window.ref && link.active && pane.active)
        (Left ChangedClientAttachment)
      let attachment = ClientAttachment session window (PaneOccurrence pane link)
      pure (Client input.name input.pid input.tty (Just attachment))

-- | One synchronous mutation and its retained ownership. A deadline bounds
-- submission as well as waiting; recovery never dispatches the command again.
module LibTmux.Internal.Mutation
  ( performMutation, performRequest, MutationRecovery, recoveryReceipt, inspectRecovery
  , resumeRecovery, awaitRecovery, detachRecovery
  ) where

import Control.Applicative ((<|>))
import Control.Concurrent.STM (STM, atomically, check)
import Control.Exception
  ( ExceptionWithContext (..), SomeException, catchNoPropagate, fromException
  , mask, onException, rethrowIO, throwIO, toException
  )
import Control.Exception.Annotation (ExceptionAnnotation)
import Control.Exception.Context qualified as Context
import Control.Monad (when)
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.IORef (newIORef, readIORef, writeIORef)
import Data.Maybe (listToMaybe)
import Data.Text qualified as Text
import Data.Word (Word64)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import LibTmux.Internal.Command qualified as C
import LibTmux.Internal.Process qualified as P
import LibTmux.Internal.Process.Native qualified as N
import LibTmux.Internal.Runtime qualified as R
import LibTmux.Internal.Scope (TmuxException (..))
import System.Timeout (timeout)

-- | Reachable ownership for one failed or cancelled mutation. The receipt
-- retains metadata only; the Runtime retains outstanding native and logical
-- owners. Recovery never repeats the command. See "LibTmux.Server".
data MutationRecovery = MutationRecovery !R.Runtime !R.ServerHandle !R.ReadReceipt
instance Show MutationRecovery where
  showsPrec precedence (MutationRecovery _ _ receipt) =
    showParen (precedence > 10) (showString "MutationRecovery " . shows receipt)
instance ExceptionAnnotation MutationRecovery

recoveryReceipt :: MutationRecovery -> R.ReadReceipt
recoveryReceipt (MutationRecovery _ _ receipt) = receipt

inspectRecovery :: MutationRecovery -> STM R.ReadRecovery
inspectRecovery (MutationRecovery runtime server receipt) = R.inspectReceipt runtime server receipt

resumeRecovery :: MutationRecovery -> IO ()
resumeRecovery recovery@(MutationRecovery runtime server receipt) =
  recovering recovery (R.resumeReceipt runtime server receipt)

awaitRecovery :: MutationRecovery -> IO R.ReadRecovery
awaitRecovery recovery = recovering recovery $ atomically $ do
  observed <- inspectRecovery recovery
  check (not observed.workerOwned && not observed.nativeOwned)
  pure observed

detachRecovery :: MutationRecovery -> STM Bool
detachRecovery (MutationRecovery runtime server receipt) = R.detachReceipt runtime server receipt

performMutation :: P.Hooks -> Int -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> C.Mutation -> IO ()
performMutation hooks duration runtime server executable mutation =
  performRequest duration runtime server
    (\remainingTime -> remainingTime >>= \left -> R.mutateWith hooks left runtime server executable mutation) $ \case
      C.Applied -> pure ()
      C.Rejected diagnostic -> throwIO (MutationRejected diagnostic)
      C.AppliedWithErrors diagnostic -> throwIO (MutationAppliedWithErrors diagnostic)

-- | Share one absolute deadline and correlated owner across typed mutations.
-- Submission obtains remaining time after its own context acquisition; the
-- decoder runs within the same deadline. Recovery never resubmits the action.
performRequest
  :: Int -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle
  -> (IO Int -> IO (R.Request value)) -> (value -> IO result) -> IO result
performRequest duration runtime server submit decode = mask $ \restore -> do
  when (duration < 1 || duration > 10000000)
    (throwIO (InvalidConfiguration "mutation timeout must be positive and at most ten seconds"))
  receipt <- newIORef Nothing
  let annotate (ExceptionWithContext context (problem :: SomeException)) = do
        current <- readIORef receipt
        let selected = current <|> listToMaybe (Context.getExceptionAnnotations @R.ReadReceipt context)
        case selected of
          Nothing -> rethrowIO (ExceptionWithContext context problem)
          Just value -> recovering (MutationRecovery runtime server value)
            (rethrowIO (ExceptionWithContext context problem))
      owned deadline = mask $ \unmask -> do
        request <- catchNoPropagate (submit (remaining deadline)) $
          \failure@(ExceptionWithContext context (problem :: SomeException)) -> do
            -- Timeout consumes its exception; retain correlation before conversion.
            writeIORef receipt (listToMaybe (Context.getExceptionAnnotations @R.ReadReceipt context))
            case (fromException @R.ReadError problem, fromException @N.Failure problem) of
              (Just (R.InvalidCommandOperands invalid), _) -> rethrowIO
                (ExceptionWithContext context (toException (InvalidMutationArgument (argumentError invalid))))
              (_, Just (N.InvalidInput reason)) -> rethrowIO
                (ExceptionWithContext context (toException (InvalidConfiguration ("native launch: " <> Text.pack reason))))
              _ -> rethrowIO failure
        let !current = R.readReceipt request
        writeIORef receipt (Just current)
        response <- unmask (R.awaitRead request) `onException` R.cancelRead runtime request
        case response of
          R.ReadValue value -> decode value
          R.ReadUnavailable _ (Just problem)
            | Just R.ReadExpired <- fromException problem -> throwIO MutationTimedOut
            | otherwise -> throwIO problem
          R.ReadUnavailable _ Nothing -> throwIO (OperationFailed (toException R.ReadCancelled))
      timed = do
        started <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        let delta = fromIntegral duration * 1000
        when (started > maxBound - delta) (throwIO R.ReadClockOverflow)
        let deadline = started + delta
        completed <- timeout duration (owned deadline)
        case completed of
          Nothing -> throwIO MutationTimedOut
          Just value -> remaining deadline >> pure value
  catchNoPropagate (restore timed) annotate
  where
    argumentError (C.NulOperand field) = field <> " contains NUL"
    argumentError (C.EncodedCommandTooLarge field) = field <> " exceeds the command size limit"
    argumentError (C.InvalidOperand field reason) = field <> ": " <> reason

remaining :: Word64 -> IO Int
remaining deadline = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  when (now >= deadline) (throwIO MutationTimedOut)
  pure (fromIntegral ((deadline - now + 999) `div` 1000))

recovering :: MutationRecovery -> IO a -> IO a
recovering recovery action = catchNoPropagate action $
  \(ExceptionWithContext context (problem :: SomeException)) ->
    rethrowIO (ExceptionWithContext (Context.addExceptionAnnotation recovery context) problem)

{-# LANGUAGE RoleAnnotations #-}

-- | Closed typed selections over owned observations. Preparation and evaluation
-- are pure; acquisition belongs to the public Server boundary.
module LibTmux.Internal.Query
  ( CardinalityError (..), exactlyOne, atMostOne
  , Expr, Query, Order, ToMany (..), ToOne (..), ToOptional (..)
  , QueryError (..), QueryRequirements (..), EvaluatorProfile (..), nativeProfile
  , eq, oneOf, contains, ge, gt, le, lt
  , dimensionAtLeast, dimensionAtMost, paneIndexAtLeast, paneIndexAtMost
  , windowIndexAtLeast, windowIndexAtMost
  , allOf, anyOf, not_, some, every, none, related, optionalRelated
  , sessions, windows, panes, windowLinks, paneOccurrences, clients, serverInfo
  , matching, orderBy, ascending, descending, limit
  , requirements, prepare, runQuery, runQueryWith, evaluateExpr
  ) where

import Control.Monad (filterM, forM_, unless, when)
import Data.Bifunctor (first)
import Data.List (sortBy)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Data.Set (Set)
import Data.Set qualified as Set
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Text qualified as Text
import LibTmux.Internal.Field qualified as F
import LibTmux.Internal.Graph qualified as G
import LibTmux.Value qualified as V
import LibTmux.Version qualified as Version
import Numeric.Natural (Natural)

-- | Selection cardinality without retaining observations or counting ambiguity.
data CardinalityError
  = NoMatches -- ^ The selection is empty where one value was required.
  | AtLeastTwoMatches -- ^ A second match exists; no complete count is computed.
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

-- | Require exactly one value. Uniqueness can require traversing the entire
-- input; ambiguity is established at the second match without forcing its tail.
-- This neither acquires data nor reserves a live command target.
exactlyOne :: [row] -> Either CardinalityError row
exactlyOne [] = Left NoMatches
exactlyOne [row] = Right row
exactlyOne (_ : _ : _) = Left AtLeastTwoMatches

-- | Permit absence but reject a second match, with the same traversal behavior
-- as 'exactlyOne'. Use ordinary @listToMaybe@ when choosing the first is intended.
atMostOne :: [row] -> Either CardinalityError (Maybe row)
atMostOne [] = Right Nothing
atMostOne [row] = Right (Just row)
atMostOne (_ : _ : _) = Left AtLeastTwoMatches

-- | A closed one-to-many relationship. Obtain tokens from the entity field
-- modules and use 'some', 'every' or 'none'. Constructors are private.
data ToMany parent child where
  SessionLinks :: ToMany G.Session G.WindowLink
  SessionClients :: ToMany G.Session G.Client
  WindowPanes :: ToMany G.Window G.Pane
  WindowLinks :: ToMany G.Window G.WindowLink
  LinkPanes :: ToMany G.WindowLink G.Pane

-- | A required relationship in a validated graph, used with 'related'.
data ToOne parent child where
  PaneWindow :: ToOne G.Pane G.Window
  LinkSession :: ToOne G.WindowLink G.Session
  LinkWindow :: ToOne G.WindowLink G.Window
  OccurrencePane :: ToOne G.PaneOccurrence G.Pane
  OccurrenceLink :: ToOne G.PaneOccurrence G.WindowLink
  AttachmentSession :: ToOne G.ClientAttachment G.Session
  AttachmentWindow :: ToOne G.ClientAttachment G.Window
  AttachmentPane :: ToOne G.ClientAttachment G.PaneOccurrence

-- | An observed optional relationship, used with 'optionalRelated'.
-- Known absence is separate from an unavailable relationship.
data ToOptional parent child where
  ClientAttachment :: ToOptional G.Client G.ClientAttachment

data Source row where
  Sessions :: Source G.Session
  Windows :: Source G.Window
  Panes :: Source G.Pane
  WindowLinksSource :: Source G.WindowLink
  Occurrences :: Source G.PaneOccurrence
  Clients :: Source G.Client
  ServerInfo :: Source G.ServerInfo

data NumberField row where
  IntegerField :: F.Field row Integer -> NumberField row
  DimensionField :: F.Field row V.Dimension -> NumberField row
  PaneIndexField :: F.Field row V.PaneIndex -> NumberField row
  WindowIndexField :: F.Field row V.WindowIndex -> NumberField row

data Comparison = AtLeast | Above | AtMost | Below
data Quantifier = Some | Every | None

type role Expr nominal
-- | A pure predicate description for one row type. Field and relationship
-- tokens retain their identity; arbitrary application functions stay outside
-- this portable representation. Nominal roles prevent cross-row coercion.
data Expr row where
  Equal :: Eq value => F.Field row value -> value -> Expr row
  OneOf :: Eq value => F.Field row value -> [value] -> Expr row
  Contains :: F.Field row Text -> Text -> Expr row
  NumberCompare :: NumberField row -> Comparison -> Integer -> Expr row
  All :: [Expr row] -> Expr row
  Any :: [Expr row] -> Expr row
  Not :: Expr row -> Expr row
  Quantified :: Quantifier -> ToMany row child -> Expr child -> Expr row
  Related :: ToOne row child -> Expr child -> Expr row
  OptionalRelated :: ToOptional row child -> Expr child -> Expr row

type role Order nominal
-- | One ascending or descending field ordering. Combine keys with 'orderBy'.
data Order row where
  Order :: Ord value => Bool -> F.Field row value -> Order row

type role Query nominal
-- | A source, predicate, stable ordering and optional final limit. Building a
-- query performs no IO and retains no Server handle. Use "LibTmux.Query" to evaluate.
data Query row = Query !(Source row) !(Expr row) ![Order row] !(Maybe Natural)

-- | Pure validation or navigation failure. Operational acquisition failures
-- remain exceptions at the Server boundary rather than becoming empty results.
data QueryError
  = FieldUnavailable !Text -- ^ Stable field key unavailable to the evaluator.
  | RelationshipUnavailable !Text -- ^ Stable relationship key unavailable to the evaluator.
  | RequiresTmux !Text !Version.TmuxVersion !Version.TmuxVersion -- ^ Field, required release and observed release.
  | InvalidFieldRequirement !Text -- ^ A catalogue entry has invalid version metadata.
  | RelationshipLookupFailed !Text !G.LookupError -- ^ Relationship key and the failed pure lookup.
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

-- | Inspectable dependencies, not a serialized query or an optimization plan.
data QueryRequirements = QueryRequirements
  { sourceName :: !Text -- ^ Stable name of the ordered root source.
  , fieldNames :: ![Text] -- ^ Sorted, deduplicated fields, including ordering keys.
  , relationshipNames :: ![Text] -- ^ Sorted, deduplicated relationships at every nesting depth.
  , orderingFields :: ![Text] -- ^ Ordering field keys in their specified priority order.
  , rowLimit :: !(Maybe Natural) -- ^ Final limit, or 'Nothing' for no limit.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

data EvaluatorProfile = EvaluatorProfile
  { availableFields :: !(Set Text)
  , availableRelationships :: !(Set Text)
  , evaluatorVersion :: !(Maybe Version.TmuxVersion)
  }

-- | Exact equality in the field's declared type. No Unicode normalization,
-- case folding or byte-to-text conversion is implicit.
eq :: Eq value => F.Field row value -> value -> Expr row
eq = Equal

-- | Membership using exact equality against a finite operand list. An empty
-- list never matches, but its field requirement is still validated.
oneOf :: Eq value => F.Field row value -> [value] -> Expr row
oneOf = OneOf

-- | Exact, case-sensitive Text substring matching. Byte-bearing fields are
-- deliberately excluded; use typed equality for their retained values.
contains :: F.Field row Text -> Text -> Expr row
contains = Contains

-- | Compare a mathematical Integer field with an unbounded threshold:
-- greater-or-equal, greater, less-or-equal or less, respectively.
ge, gt, le, lt :: F.Field row Integer -> Integer -> Expr row
ge field = NumberCompare (IntegerField field) AtLeast
gt field = NumberCompare (IntegerField field) Above
le field = NumberCompare (IntegerField field) AtMost
lt field = NumberCompare (IntegerField field) Below

-- | Compare a positive cell dimension to an Integer threshold, inclusively.
-- Negative and arbitrarily large thresholds are valid predicates; they do not
-- construct a command dimension. Use 'not_' for a strict opposite bound.
dimensionAtLeast, dimensionAtMost :: F.Field row V.Dimension -> Integer -> Expr row
dimensionAtLeast field = NumberCompare (DimensionField field) AtLeast
dimensionAtMost field = NumberCompare (DimensionField field) AtMost

-- | Inclusive bounds on a pane index, without narrowing or constructing an index.
paneIndexAtLeast, paneIndexAtMost :: F.Field row V.PaneIndex -> Integer -> Expr row
paneIndexAtLeast field = NumberCompare (PaneIndexField field) AtLeast
paneIndexAtMost field = NumberCompare (PaneIndexField field) AtMost

-- | Inclusive bounds on a contextual window index, using Integer thresholds.
windowIndexAtLeast, windowIndexAtMost :: F.Field row V.WindowIndex -> Integer -> Expr row
windowIndexAtLeast field = NumberCompare (WindowIndexField field) AtLeast
windowIndexAtMost field = NumberCompare (WindowIndexField field) AtMost

-- | Finite conjunction and disjunction. Empty lists mean True and False,
-- respectively. Validation checks every branch before evaluation short-circuits.
allOf, anyOf :: [Expr row] -> Expr row
allOf = All
anyOf = Any

-- | Logical negation, preserving the expression's validation requirements.
not_ :: Expr row -> Expr row
not_ = Not

-- | Existential, universal or absent matching children. A known empty
-- relationship yields False, True or True, respectively. The child expression
-- applies to one child at a time; put conditions inside one 'allOf' when the
-- same child must satisfy them. Unavailable relationships remain errors.
some, every, none :: ToMany row child -> Expr child -> Expr row
some = Quantified Some
every = Quantified Every
none = Quantified None

-- | Test the required related observation in the supplied snapshot.
-- A failed lookup returns 'RelationshipLookupFailed', never False or absence.
related :: ToOne row child -> Expr child -> Expr row
related = Related

-- | Test a known optional target. Absence yields False, so negation includes
-- absence as well as targets that fail the child predicate.
optionalRelated :: ToOptional row child -> Expr child -> Expr row
optionalRelated = OptionalRelated

-- | Physical sessions in numeric ID order.
sessions :: Query G.Session
sessions = Query Sessions (All []) [] Nothing
-- | Unique physical windows in numeric ID order, independent of their links.
windows :: Query G.Window
windows = Query Windows (All []) [] Nothing
-- | Unique physical panes in numeric ID order; use 'paneOccurrences' for context.
panes :: Query G.Pane
panes = Query Panes (All []) [] Nothing
-- | Contextual links in session-ID then window-index order, retaining multiplicity.
windowLinks :: Query G.WindowLink
windowLinks = Query WindowLinksSource (All []) [] Nothing
-- | Pane appearances in link order, then pane-index order within each window.
paneOccurrences :: Query G.PaneOccurrence
paneOccurrences = Query Occurrences (All []) [] Nothing
-- | Captured clients in bytewise name order, then PID.
clients :: Query G.Client
clients = Query Clients (All []) [] Nothing
-- | The single captured daemon-metadata observation.
serverInfo :: Query G.ServerInfo
serverInfo = Query ServerInfo (All []) [] Nothing

-- | Conjoin a predicate with existing predicates without changing the source.
matching :: Expr row -> Query row -> Query row
matching condition (Query source previous orders bound) =
  Query source (All [previous, condition]) orders bound

-- | Replace the ordering keys. Sorting is stable and follows filtering;
-- an empty key list retains source order. Limits are always applied afterward.
orderBy :: [Order row] -> Query row -> Query row
orderBy orders (Query source condition _ bound) = Query source condition orders bound

-- | Order by the declared field's Ord instance in ascending or descending order.
-- Text and byte-bearing types retain their own comparison semantics.
ascending, descending :: Ord value => F.Field row value -> Order row
ascending = Order False
descending = Order True

-- | Replace the final nonnegative limit, applied after filtering and ordering
-- regardless of builder order. A zero limit still validates every requirement.
limit :: Natural -> Query row -> Query row
limit bound (Query source condition orders _) = Query source condition orders (Just bound)

nativeProfile :: EvaluatorProfile
nativeProfile = EvaluatorProfile
  (Set.fromList [F.fieldKey field | F.SomeField field <- F.catalogue])
  (Set.fromList
    [ fst (manyDescriptor SessionLinks), fst (manyDescriptor SessionClients)
    , fst (manyDescriptor WindowPanes), fst (manyDescriptor WindowLinks), fst (manyDescriptor LinkPanes)
    , fst (oneDescriptor PaneWindow), fst (oneDescriptor LinkSession), fst (oneDescriptor LinkWindow)
    , fst (oneDescriptor OccurrencePane), fst (oneDescriptor OccurrenceLink)
    , fst (oneDescriptor AttachmentSession), fst (oneDescriptor AttachmentWindow), fst (oneDescriptor AttachmentPane)
    , fst (optionalDescriptor ClientAttachment)
    ]) Nothing

-- | Collect every declared field and relationship, including ordering and
-- branches that may short-circuit. This is pure and does not contact tmux.
requirements :: Query row -> QueryRequirements
requirements (Query source condition orders bound) =
  let (fields, relationships) = exprRequirements condition
      allFields = fields <> map orderField orders
  in QueryRequirements (sourceKey source)
       (Set.toAscList (Set.fromList (map someFieldKey allFields)))
       (Set.toAscList relationships) (map (someFieldKey . orderField) orders) bound

prepare :: EvaluatorProfile -> Query row -> Either QueryError ()
prepare profile (Query _ condition orders _) = do
  let (fields, relationships) = exprRequirements condition
      uniqueFields = Map.fromList [(someFieldKey field, field) | field <- fields <> map orderField orders]
  forM_ (Map.elems uniqueFields) $ \(F.SomeField field) -> do
    let key = F.fieldKey field
    unless (Set.member key profile.availableFields) (Left (FieldUnavailable key))
    minimumVersion <- first (const (InvalidFieldRequirement key)) (Version.parseVersion (F.minimumTmux field))
    forM_ profile.evaluatorVersion $ \actual ->
      when (actual < minimumVersion) (Left (RequiresTmux key minimumVersion actual))
  forM_ (Set.toAscList relationships) $ \key ->
    unless (Set.member key profile.availableRelationships) (Left (RelationshipUnavailable key))

-- | Validate and evaluate against the supplied complete snapshot. Every
-- requirement is checked before reading rows, even for empty sources and
-- zero limits. Returning Right means consuming the result performs only pure
-- processing of owned observations. No acquisition, pushdown or refresh occurs.
runQuery :: G.Snapshot -> Query row -> Either QueryError [row]
runQuery snapshot = runQueryWith
  (nativeProfile {evaluatorVersion = Just (G.serverInfo snapshot).version}) snapshot

runQueryWith :: EvaluatorProfile -> G.Snapshot -> Query row -> Either QueryError [row]
runQueryWith profile snapshot query@(Query source condition orders bound) = do
  prepare profile query
  rows <- filterM (evaluateExpr snapshot condition) (sourceRows snapshot source)
  let ordered = if null orders then rows else sortBy (compareRows orders) rows
  pure (maybe ordered (`takeNatural` ordered) bound)

evaluateExpr :: G.Snapshot -> Expr row -> row -> Either QueryError Bool
evaluateExpr snapshot expression row = case expression of
  Equal field value -> Right (F.project field row == value)
  OneOf field values -> Right (F.project field row `elem` values)
  Contains field value -> Right (value `Text.isInfixOf` F.project field row)
  NumberCompare field comparison value -> Right (compareNumber comparison (numberValue field row) value)
  All values -> allM (\value -> evaluateExpr snapshot value row) values
  Any values -> anyM (\value -> evaluateExpr snapshot value row) values
  Not value -> not <$> evaluateExpr snapshot value row
  Quantified quantifier relation condition -> do
    let (key, get) = manyDescriptor relation
    children <- first (RelationshipLookupFailed key) (get snapshot row)
    case quantifier of
      Some -> anyM (evaluateExpr snapshot condition) children
      Every -> allM (evaluateExpr snapshot condition) children
      None -> not <$> anyM (evaluateExpr snapshot condition) children
  Related relation condition -> do
    let (key, get) = oneDescriptor relation
    child <- first (RelationshipLookupFailed key) (get snapshot row)
    evaluateExpr snapshot condition child
  OptionalRelated relation condition -> do
    let (key, get) = optionalDescriptor relation
    child <- first (RelationshipLookupFailed key) (get snapshot row)
    maybe (Right False) (evaluateExpr snapshot condition) child

someFieldKey :: F.SomeField -> Text
someFieldKey (F.SomeField field) = F.fieldKey field

orderField :: Order row -> F.SomeField
orderField (Order _ field) = F.SomeField field

numberRequirement :: NumberField row -> F.SomeField
numberRequirement = \case
  IntegerField field -> F.SomeField field
  DimensionField field -> F.SomeField field
  PaneIndexField field -> F.SomeField field
  WindowIndexField field -> F.SomeField field

exprRequirements :: Expr row -> ([F.SomeField], Set Text)
exprRequirements = \case
  Equal field _ -> ([F.SomeField field], Set.empty)
  OneOf field _ -> ([F.SomeField field], Set.empty)
  Contains field _ -> ([F.SomeField field], Set.empty)
  NumberCompare field _ _ -> ([numberRequirement field], Set.empty)
  All values -> foldMap exprRequirements values
  Any values -> foldMap exprRequirements values
  Not value -> exprRequirements value
  Quantified _ relation condition -> withRelationship (fst (manyDescriptor relation)) (exprRequirements condition)
  Related relation condition -> withRelationship (fst (oneDescriptor relation)) (exprRequirements condition)
  OptionalRelated relation condition -> withRelationship (fst (optionalDescriptor relation)) (exprRequirements condition)
  where
    withRelationship key (fields, relationships) = (fields, Set.insert key relationships)

numberValue :: NumberField row -> row -> Integer
numberValue field row = case field of
  IntegerField value -> F.project value row
  DimensionField value -> V.dimensionValue (F.project value row)
  PaneIndexField value -> V.paneIndexValue (F.project value row)
  WindowIndexField value -> V.windowIndexValue (F.project value row)

compareNumber :: Comparison -> Integer -> Integer -> Bool
compareNumber = \case AtLeast -> (>=); Above -> (>); AtMost -> (<=); Below -> (<)

compareRows :: [Order row] -> row -> row -> Ordering
compareRows orders left right = foldMap compareField orders
  where
    compareField (Order reversed field)
      | reversed = compare (F.project field right) (F.project field left)
      | otherwise = compare (F.project field left) (F.project field right)

takeNatural :: Natural -> [row] -> [row]
takeNatural 0 _ = []
takeNatural _ [] = []
takeNatural count (row : rows) = row : takeNatural (count - 1) rows

allM :: (value -> Either problem Bool) -> [value] -> Either problem Bool
allM _ [] = Right True
allM predicate (value : values) = do
  matched <- predicate value
  if matched then allM predicate values else Right False

anyM :: (value -> Either problem Bool) -> [value] -> Either problem Bool
anyM _ [] = Right False
anyM predicate (value : values) = do
  matched <- predicate value
  if matched then Right True else anyM predicate values

sourceKey :: Source row -> Text
sourceKey = \case
  Sessions -> "sessions"
  Windows -> "windows"
  Panes -> "panes"
  WindowLinksSource -> "windowLinks"
  Occurrences -> "paneOccurrences"
  Clients -> "clients"
  ServerInfo -> "serverInfo"

sourceRows :: G.Snapshot -> Source row -> [row]
sourceRows snapshot = \case
  Sessions -> G.graphSessions graph
  Windows -> G.graphWindows graph
  Panes -> G.graphPanes graph
  WindowLinksSource -> G.graphLinks graph
  Occurrences -> G.graphOccurrences graph
  Clients -> G.clients snapshot
  ServerInfo -> [G.serverInfo snapshot]
  where graph = G.entities snapshot

-- Each closed descriptor owns both its stable identity and its navigation.
manyDescriptor :: ToMany parent child -> (Text, G.Snapshot -> parent -> Either G.LookupError [child])
manyDescriptor = \case
  SessionLinks -> ("session.windowLinks", \snapshot row -> G.linksForSession (G.entities snapshot) row.ref)
  SessionClients -> ("session.clients", \snapshot row -> Right
    [ client | client <- G.clients snapshot, Just attachment <- [client.attachment]
    , attachment.session.ref == row.ref ])
  WindowPanes -> ("window.panes", \snapshot row -> G.panesForWindow (G.entities snapshot) row.ref)
  WindowLinks -> ("window.windowLinks", \snapshot row -> do
    _ <- G.lookupWindow (G.entities snapshot) row.ref
    Right [link | link <- G.graphLinks (G.entities snapshot), link.window == row.ref])
  LinkPanes -> ("windowLink.panes", \snapshot row -> G.panesForWindow (G.entities snapshot) row.window)

oneDescriptor :: ToOne parent child -> (Text, G.Snapshot -> parent -> Either G.LookupError child)
oneDescriptor = \case
  PaneWindow -> ("pane.window", \snapshot row -> G.lookupWindow (G.entities snapshot) row.window)
  LinkSession -> ("windowLink.session", \snapshot row -> G.lookupSession (G.entities snapshot) row.session)
  LinkWindow -> ("windowLink.window", \snapshot row -> G.lookupWindow (G.entities snapshot) row.window)
  OccurrencePane -> ("paneOccurrence.pane", \_ row -> Right row.pane)
  OccurrenceLink -> ("paneOccurrence.link", \_ row -> Right row.link)
  AttachmentSession -> ("clientAttachment.session", \_ row -> Right row.session)
  AttachmentWindow -> ("clientAttachment.window", \_ row -> Right row.window)
  AttachmentPane -> ("clientAttachment.pane", \_ row -> Right row.pane)

optionalDescriptor :: ToOptional parent child -> (Text, G.Snapshot -> parent -> Either G.LookupError (Maybe child))
optionalDescriptor = \case
  ClientAttachment -> ("client.attachment", \_ row -> Right row.attachment)

--
-- A t'Runtime' registers a fresh pin owner and its process pool before
-- adoption can create filesystem names. Failed or cancelled adoption leaves
-- cleanup owned here. 'inspect' retires only successfully cleaned entries;
-- 'awaitCleanup' may wait without a deadline. 'shutdown' bounds its two
-- observation phases while retaining incomplete cleanup. Read and mutation
-- requests bind logical admission and deadlines to native ownership.
-- "LibTmux.Server" exposes the Server and shared Runtime scopes.
